name: Chikitsak
description: Chikitsak has been made to scale up the existing telemedicine and Patient MIS in rural areas using Azure Services and Serverless Architecture to provide a cost-economic one stop solution which is dependable and truly secure. The objective is to give the citizens a Live Doctor Interface which has a serverless architecture and can be remotely accessed irrespective of patient's geographical location.

features: Once user installs Chikitsak on his phone, he can schedule a test, communicate with a doctor, request appointment and view all his previous data in a cost effective way.
Our prime focus is on user's cost and privacy. The passwords are securely stored without the intervention of any third-party applications and this prevents dataleaks from occuring.
